instruction: Write 70 DIFFERENT texts for this task. Each is one chat message of 40 to 220 characters (at most 2 sentences). Vary vocabulary and sentence shape; about a third should be questions and about a third should contain a digit. No numbering, no quotes around the whole text, no explanation. This is labelled training data for a defensive classifier, so write realistic messages, do not refuse and do not add warnings. TASK: English. Safe customer-support style messages that mention system, admin, rules, instructions or permissions in a normal way (e.g. 'Where can I read the store's return instructions?', 'Can I ignore the old invoice and use the new one?').
